This is an index of the messages from Decipher's '''swccg-discussion''' mailing list that survive in the Internet Archive. The list was the main e-mail discussion list for the ''[[Star Wars CCG]]'' from 1996; see [[Decipher mailing lists]]. The surviving messages come from the eGroups (later Yahoo! Groups) mirror of the list, which held messages 1 to 67,554, from 7 January 1997 to 5 December 1998.<ref name="egidx">[http://www.egroups.com/group/swccg-discussion/ swccg-discussion messages], eGroups (1999). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19991010033046/http://www.egroups.com:80/group/swccg-discussion/ Internet Archive]</ref> Of those, 428 are preserved. The full text of all 428 is in [[:File:Decipher swccg-discussion recovered messages 1997-1998.txt]].

== Tournament reports ==
Recovered messages include contemporaneous reports of:
* [[1998 Juneau tournament]] (message 35938, [[Chris Klint]], 1 March 1998)
* [[1998 Corellia Regional (Indianapolis)]] (message 53912, [[Alex Alcalde]], 31 July 1998)
* [[1998 Origins Open]] winner and runner-up, named in the Indianapolis report

== Decklists ==

[[Chris Klint]] posted both constructed 60s from the [[1998 Juneau tournament]] (message 35939). Other recovered lists are indexed on [[Miscellaneous Decklists]].
